request.spec: Let me put labels on projects so I can group them.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read CLAUDE.md — it states the working rules, the project layout, and the data-testid
conventions. Follow it.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Let me put labels on projects so I can group them.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, and any audit records it
expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as you work;
iterate until it passes. Implement the full-stack change (database migration + OfficeFloor
server + front-end). Do NOT edit the pinned scaffolding (bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop,
bin/e2e, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md) or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The change is complete and the acceptance test passes (`1 passed`).

## What I built

A full-stack "tags on projects" feature, added entirely as new files (plus the two evolving seed/reset hooks the rules permit editing).

**Database** — `V16__project_tags.sql`: a `tags` table (reusable labels) and a `project_tags` join table with a surrogate IDENTITY id and a `UNIQUE (project_id, tag_id)` so a project is never double-tagged.

**Server (OfficeFloor REST)** — four new endpoints, each a YAML + logic class:
- `GET /api/tags` — the full tag catalogue (for the picker)
- `GET /api/project-tags?projectId=` — the tags on one project
- `POST /api/project-tags/add` and `/remove` — `{projectId, tagId}` body, returning the updated tag list; each audits through the `Audit` service (`PROJECT_TAGGED` / `PROJECT_UNTAGGED`)

New `Tag`/`ProjectTag` entities and their `JpaRepository` beans. `TestSupportController` reset now truncates the two tables, and seed inserts `tags` (explicit fixture ids) and `projectTags` (the pair; join id is IDENTITY-generated).

**Front-end** — additive per CLAUDE.md rule 3: a new `tags.slot.tsx` fills the existing `project.detail` region (no route edited), rendering `ProjectTags` with its own query hooks in `tags.ts`. It shows each tag as `project-tag-<id>`, a `project-tag-remove-<id>` button, a `project-tag-add` select (options keyed by tag id, listing tags not yet assigned), and a `project-tag-add-submit` button. Data is `useQuery` under shared keys, mutations invalidate `['project-tags', projectId]`, and `useState` holds only the uncommitted picker selection.

All `data-testid` anchors match the spec exactly, and `npm run typecheck` is clean.
